subject: planner: remove empty selection (#62332)
summary: Reviewed commit diff vs first parent. Change adds a new logical opt rule `EmptySelectionEliminator` to remove `LogicalSelection` nodes with `len(Conditions)==0`, wires it into the logical rule list/flags, and enables the flag for join building and IN-subquery-to-join rewrite paths. Removal is semantics-preserving (empty CNF conjunction) and does not touch privilege/txn/session/protocol behaviors; no Blocker/High correctness or compatibility issues found in the touched planner code.
